title: Archival Asset
description: A sourced (not generated) still/video pulled from a real public/open archive - Wikimedia Commons, NASA Images, or Archive.org - by scripts/find_reference_images.py. Distinct from reference_asset.schema.json's REF-* generation references (M09 §8b): this is never immutable, always carries a license and a citable source_url, and is the one asset-sourcing path that can make project.json's rights.source_basis: "public_domain" an evidenced claim instead of an inference.

query.description: The search keywords used to find this candidate.

source_title.description: The archive's own title/identifier for the item (Commons page title, NASA nasa_id, Archive.org identifier).

source_url.description: Human-viewable page for the item at its source archive - the right citation for project.json's rights.evidence_ref.

file_url.description: Direct URL to the downloaded file, at the resolution actually retrieved.

license.description: Short license name as reported by the source (e.g. "cc-by-sa-4.0", "public domain"). Never empty - an asset with an unclear/missing license is rejected before this record is ever written (M09 §8b).

attribution.description: Photographer/artist/credit string, empty string if the source provides none (public domain often has none).

local_path.description: Path relative to repo root where the file was downloaded.
